stories.title: Crypto firms freeze more than $3bn in funds as Binance investigates potential hack
stories.take: Crypto firms froze about $3bn by Thursday evening as Binance, the world's largest exchange, investigated a suspected hack and paused withdrawals — the damage is still unconfirmed.

stories.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
stories.take: Jassy says AWS can be a $1 trillion business — but only if Amazon keeps spending big on AI capacity first.

stories.title: Amazon reported booming cloud revenue but otherwise missed expectations
stories.take: The other half of Amazon's earnings: cloud boomed, the rest missed, and free cash flow went negative at -$2.4 billion.

stories.title: Reddit is moving to “a logged-in-only experience,” CEO says
stories.take: Reddit will eventually require a login, its CEO confirmed, after AI search cut its search traffic meaningfully last quarter.

stories.title: What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
stories.take: Platformer's read: AI search is underperforming for Google and killing Reddit's traffic at the same time — both have the same problem.

stories.title: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
stories.take: GM pays $220 million and must now get drivers' express consent before collecting or sharing driving and location data.

stories.title: Trump declares robot imports a national security threat
stories.take: Trump ordered trade talks on foreign-made factory robots and threatened tariffs, framing robot imports as a national security threat.

stories.title: Fan-fiction site Archive of Our Own (AO3) could be offline for up to 4 weeks after security incident
stories.take: AO3 could be offline for up to four weeks after a security incident — and its status posts drew millions of panicked views within hours.

stories.title: The R2 SUV is already Rivian’s best-selling vehicle
stories.take: Rivian's R2 is already its best-seller, strong enough that the company raised guidance for the second time this year.

stories.title: Amazon Says External AI Agents Aren’t Hurting Its Ad Business
stories.take: Amazon says outside AI agents aren't hurting ads — and posted its highest-ever operating margin, 13.9% in Q3.

stories.title: Stagwell Posts Best Results Yet as Mark Penn Eyes Government Contracts
stories.take: Stagwell posted its best results yet; Mark Penn says its AI tools can cut clients' marketing costs by $100 million a year, and he's eyeing government contracts.

stories.title: The creator economy has a payments problem
stories.take: Creators are commanding bigger roles and paydays — the bottleneck now isn't talent, it's simply getting them paid.

stories.title: Disney plans TikTok Shop holiday experience with over 20 brands
stories.take: Disney is turning TikTok Shop into a holiday storefront, with a Super Brand Day in November spanning 20-plus brands.

stories.title: Why the 2026 midterms could mark a turning point for influencers in political campaigns
stories.take: Campaigns are recruiting creators for the midterms while disclosure rules lag — voter trust is the real battleground.

stories.title: Prada's hand-drawn holiday campaign is an utter joy – and a sharp lesson for Coca-Cola
stories.take: Prada's pencil-and-paper holiday campaign is a welcome break from AI slop — and a pointed lesson for Coca-Cola.

stories.title: The Sydney Sweeney Effect Can Fade Fast for Brands, Data Suggests
stories.take: The Sweeney boost fades fast in the data: American Eagle's early lift didn't last, and Dr. Squatch saw no durable direct-sales gain.

stories.title: Curry torches Wolves for 44 as Warriors win 2nd straight after 0-3 start
stories.take: Curry dropped 44 in a 119-114 win over Minnesota — Golden State's second straight win after an 0-3 start.

stories.title: Jokic notches 200th career triple-double, now 9 behind Westbrook's NBA record
stories.take: Jokic's 21-13-10 against the Pelicans was his 200th career triple-double — he needs 10 more to pass Westbrook for the record.

stories.title: Giannis wins first with Heat behind 24-18 night; Bam sets rebounding mark
stories.take: Giannis got his first Heat win with 24 points and 18 rebounds, on the night Bam Adebayo became Miami's all-time rebounding leader.

stories.title: Jaylen Brown insists he never demanded Celtics trade, pushes back on 'false allegations' from Brian Scalabrine
stories.take: Now with the 76ers, Brown flatly denies he ever gave Boston ultimatums or a trade demand this summer.

stories.title: Timberwolves' Edwards undergoes successful knee scope
stories.take: Minnesota's Anthony Edwards underwent a successful knee scope — the injury story that could reshape the Wolves' season.

stories.title: Victor Wembanyama on 60 Minutes: Spurs star explains why 'villain' label didn't bother him during NBA Finals
stories.take: Wembanyama tells 60 Minutes the 'villain' label from the Finals never bothered him.

stories.title: 🏀 Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale and the uncertainty that still looms
stories.take: Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale — and the uncertainty that still looms over the franchise after it.

stories.title: 'Can't measure the heart': Brewers win franchise's first World Series title
stories.take: Milwaukee beat the Rays in Game 5 on Wednesday night for the first title in the franchise's 57-year history.

stories.title: A closed-door meeting, the belief of an entire state and a World Series title at last: How Brewers became a forever team
stories.take: How a closed-door meeting and a whole state's belief turned the 2026 Brewers into a forever team.

stories.title: Brewers set World Series parade for Friday, two days after winning 2026 title
stories.take: The celebration is set: Milwaukee's World Series parade is Friday, two days after the title.

stories.title: Champion Brewers trail Dodgers in '27 World Series title odds
stories.take: Even as champions, Milwaukee opens behind the Dodgers in 2027 title odds.

stories.title: Ranking the top 50 MLB free agents for the 2026-27 offseason, plus landing spots for every player
stories.take: The offseason starts now: the top 50 free agents, ranked, with a landing spot projected for every one.

stories.title: Braves exercise options on Acuña, Albies
stories.take: Atlanta kept its core: Acuña's $17 million option and Albies' $7 million option were both exercised Thursday.

stories.title: Rays' Franco has pardon revoked, upholding conviction in sex abuse case
stories.take: A Dominican appeals court revoked Wander Franco's pardon, upholding his conviction for sexual and psychological abuse of a minor.

stories.title: Ukraine war briefing: Outrage in Europe after Russian drone kills 14 on rail platform in Dnipro
stories.take: A Russian drone killed 14 people on a Dnipro rail platform; Europe's leaders called it cruel and devastating, and Zelenskyy warned more missile strikes are coming.

stories.title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek actor and acclaimed thespian, dies aged 86
stories.take: Patrick Stewart died at his Los Angeles home at 86, after what his family called a brief journey with Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia.

stories.title: Hegseth reportedly fires high-ranking army strategist over alleged leaks
stories.take: Hegseth reportedly dismissed Lt Gen Brett Sylvia over alleged leaks of classified information, with the case referred for criminal investigation.

stories.title: Netanyahu's party claims Israeli election 'stolen' as results show him losing majority
stories.take: Netanyahu's bloc won 53 of 120 seats, well below its previous 68 — and his party is claiming the election was stolen.

stories.title: Justice Department issues subpoenas to California election workers
stories.take: DOJ grand jury subpoenas landed on Los Angeles election workers, escalating the fight over California's voter rolls — full story in California below.

stories.title: DoorDash offers $17 billion for Instacart in what would be big grocery delivery consolidation
stories.take: DoorDash offered $17 billion for Instacart, a tie-up that would reshape grocery delivery overnight.

stories.title: New survey finds more than two-thirds of Americans believe their country is in decline
stories.take: More than two-thirds of Americans now say the country is in decline, a new survey finds.

stories.title: Senate is skeptical about making daylight saving time permanent despite Trump's pressure
stories.take: Despite Trump's pressure, the Senate remains skeptical about making daylight saving time permanent.

stories.title: California high-speed rail chief quits amid billowing expenses scandal
stories.take: Ian Choudri resigned after a state watchdog found the rail authority misused over $600,000 in public funds, including $543,000 in improper travel reimbursements.

stories.title: DOJ subpoenas California election officials, despite judge’s order to stop threatening them
stories.take: Federal officials served a subpoena on Orange County's Registrar of Voters on Thursday, despite a judge's order to stop threatening election officials.

stories.title: Judge denies federal request to segregate California ballots, says it would 'wreak havoc' on voting
stories.take: A judge rejected the Trump administration's bid to segregate up to 20,000 California ballots, warning it would wreak havoc on the midterms.

stories.title: 'This is the worst it's been.' King tides flood Southern California beach bars and restaurants
stories.take: Record king tides are flooding SoCal beach bars and restaurants — 'the worst it's been' — with more El Niño storms forecast.

stories.title: California county abandons repair plans for crumbling coastal road ahead of El Niño-fueled winter
stories.take: Humboldt County is giving up on repairing a fast-eroding coastal road, saying the fixes may already be too late ahead of an El Niño winter.

stories.title: Did Trump invest more money in rural California health ahead of the election?
stories.take: CalMatters fact-checks the $233 million announced for rural California health care — and traces where the money actually comes from.

stories.title: For the record: Fresno man deported by ICE had previous illegal crossings
stories.take: Federal authorities say the Fresno man deported by ICE had been deported five times before his recent arrest.

stories.title: The U.S. Economy Has Its Best Quarter in a Year
stories.take: Q3 GDP grew 3.4% annualized, the fastest in a year, driven by consumer spending and AI business investment — AI alone was roughly a third of all growth • Alphabet fell ~13%, erasing about $500B, on AI costs and slowing search • DoorDash's ~$17B Instacart deal, the biggest in its history, also leads the episode • Debt hit 100% of GDP for the first time since 1946, and the strong data reinforces expectations of a Fed hike next meeting

stories.title: Michigan's Senate race is coming down to the wire
stories.take: Michigan is a true toss-up: Democrats have held the seat since the late 1970s and the state hasn't elected a Republican senator since 1994 • Progressive epidemiologist Abdul El-Sayyad runs on Medicare for All and getting corporate money out of politics, warning a loss could give Trump two more Supreme Court picks — five in total • Mike Rogers, who broke with Trump after Jan. 6, now aligns with him while Rogers' campaign ties El-Sayyad to Hamas and Hezbollah, attacks El-Sayyad calls a distraction • Both sides are running on negative partisanship — stopping the other side matters more than enthusiasm for their own

stories.title: The touchscreen MacBook Apple said it wouldn't make
stories.take: Bottom line: touch is the least important thing about the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR — the weight cut (about a pound on the big model) and the OLED matter more every day; touch is an occasional nice-to-have for timelines, pinch-zoom and iPhone Mirroring • No Apple Pencil support: executives just say 'iPad' — the hosts bet it arrives eventually • macOS changes are minimal: magnifying traffic lights, trackpad gestures on screen, controls that expand under your finger • The real stakes are pricing — if touch adds $100–200 as it spreads across the lineup, expectations change; plus, Pierce's new favorite gadget, Pebble's $75 Index 01 voice-input ring

stories.title: Earnings Special: Intel Plunges on PC Sales Slump & Amazon Slips
stories.take: Intel fell more than 20% after missing its revenue forecast: weak PC demand, data-center supply it can't get enough of, and gross margin down 600-plus basis points — despite a data-center beat • Amazon slipped ~6.7% after hours: AWS grew 39%, only meeting expectations while Google and Microsoft beat, and trailing free cash flow is a $42.4B outflow on ~$220B of capex • BI stays upbeat on Amazon: AWS guides above 40% growth in 2027 and 2028 at ~39% operating margins • The shared risk: higher rates and growing political opposition to data-center builds could delay the payoff
